updates.text: 5 partners want to work with us: MSBL (member offer), Tredict, Momentum, Ohio State Triathlon and Stress Platform. Roy Hobbs declined. John cancelled the HOSR, WNBF and MSBL World Series tables.
Still open: the RRCA expo table ($1,200, John: doubtful), Search-1 ($68.97 this week), Instagram boosts ($81.25 billed) and the Nocturnal vendor call. HOSR ($300) and WNBF ($250) are cancelled.

1 call: Nocturnal, Mon 12 Oct, 2 pm EDT (paid vendor; prep brief on the daily briefing). No bookings on the Vybe Health calendar. A battery supplier wants to reschedule a call the other sender set up.
13 drafts are waiting with John on CC: 9 new today (including John's Momentum, Ohio State Tri and Tredict replies and three cancellations) and 4 from 10 Oct. Next follow-ups are due 16 Oct.
Garmin's CIRQA band is screen-free with no subscription and shows HRV, like Polar's Loop. All 45 competitor deals were re-checked on 11 Oct; none changed.
120 sessions (474 the week before), 50 from the US. 4 waitlist signups, up from 1 (one may be a test). Visits are down to about 10 a day.
7 Google clicks from 106 impressions (1 from 73 the week before). The homepage earned 5; /band and the WHOOP alternative page 1 each.
1,096 followers (up 8) and 8 posts. Reels reach far more people than images: 433 for the 1 Oct Reel, against 18 to 61 for images.
$68.97 on Google this week ($140.26 the week before), all Search-1. Instagram boosts restarted on 10 Oct on a second Meta account the dashboard can't read.
